sources.title: Caring for Women Subjected to Violence: A WHO Training Curriculum for Health Care Providers, Revised Edition
sources.scope_note: Primarily addresses health-care responses to violence against women. It is not a child-specific standard and is not a Tanzania referral directory.
sources.license_note: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; review licensing conditions before commercial reuse or adaptation.
use_limitations: Do not present as Tanzanian legislation.
Do not assume its adult-women guidance is sufficient for children or adolescents under 18.
Do not infer local referral contacts from this document.

sources.title: The Law of the Child Act, Cap. 13, Revised Edition 2023
sources.scope_note: The Act's application clause identifies Mainland Tanzania. Do not apply it to Zanzibar.
use_limitations: Use only within the Act's jurisdiction and actual provisions.
Do not use AI to determine guilt, make legal findings, or replace social welfare officers, police, courts, or lawyers.
This package summarizes selected provisions; it is not a full legal commentary.

sources.title: Health Care for Women Subjected to Intimate Partner Violence or Sexual Violence: A Clinical Handbook
sources.jurisdiction: Global health guidance; not Tanzania law
sources.scope_note: Provides first-line support and clinical-care guidance for women. It does not replace current Tanzanian clinical protocols and is not specifically designed as a child/adolescent protocol.
use_limitations: Clinical procedures and treatment information must be checked against current Mainland Tanzania clinical guidance by qualified professionals.
Do not diagnose, prescribe, or direct forensic examinations.
For children and adolescents, use child-specific standards and applicable Mainland child-protection law.

sources.title: The National Plan of Action to End Violence Against Women and Children (NPA-VAWC II 2024/25–2028/29)
sources.jurisdiction: Tanzania national plan; this package is configured for Mainland Tanzania implementation only
sources.scope_note: The package does not configure Zanzibar referrals, legal rules, or service contacts. Confirm the plan's institutional coverage and Mainland implementation arrangements before production use.
use_limitations: A policy plan is not itself a substitute for legislation.
Do not infer that SalamaLine is endorsed, funded, or connected to government mechanisms.
Do not treat plan indicators or historical survey figures as current real-time prevalence.
